matched_pcm_protocol.interpretation: Compare baseline and compact at the same warmup, thread ownership and call order. Within-backend repetition differences remain recorded; no archived golden or tolerance was changed.

connectivity_observation.collector: PC standard-library ICMP probes every 5 seconds; same PC gateway control
connectivity_observation.interpretation: Lost device ICMP responses occurred while the guarded PCM comparison had minimum MemAvailable 3373724 KiB, no swap-out and no OOM; gateway responses all succeeded. This does not support RAM exhaustion as the sole explanation, and does not identify a NIC/router/SSH cause or exclude sub-sample transients.
connectivity_observation.pressure_boundary: Kernel /proc/pressure/memory absent. The first task-only pressure collector stopped that optional snapshot on FileNotFoundError; independent MemoryWatch counters remained active. Later candidate telemetry reads meminfo and vmstat independently of optional PSI.

managed_allocator_trial.activation_boundary: The host supervisor changed the existing runtime configuration and restarted the same image. Actual worker environment was not separately captured before restoration; do not infer numeric/latency properties from this failed startup.
